name: text-and-source-product-gates-v1

research_ceiling.resource_policy: Run if exact single-input mode and complete archive accounting are reproducible within the research budget.
Use the strongest level completing within the research budget. Any pretraining dictionaries or expression files required to decode count in full.
Run only on a declared host with at least 32 GiB RAM and within the research time budget.
Run only when the official implementation, model assets, and decoder can be pinned and completely accounted within the research budget.

comparability_policy.practical_gate: The ratio-oriented product must beat the smallest eligible practical_required complete artifact. Every required baseline must be reproduced on identical derived bytes or marked infrastructure-failed; missing, unavailable, timed-out, or inexact baselines cannot be counted as wins.
comparability_policy.research_context: Research-ceiling compressors never disappear from the chart. A product may pass the practical gate without beating them, but no strongest-ratio, world-best, or state-of-the-art wording is allowed unless it also beats every eligible completed research-ceiling result under exact complete accounting.
comparability_policy.single_file_rule: All competitors receive one identical derived category item and produce one self-contained decodable artifact. Directory metadata, solid-archive advantages, external models, preprocessors, and dictionaries must be equally framed and counted.
comparability_policy.famous_benchmark_rule: Published enwik8/enwik9 results are context only and never substitute for a same-run frozen split.

research_budget.reason: Research-ceiling runs are ratio context, not a practical speed tier. Wall time and memory remain bounded and visible.

decision_rule: A track and mode pass only if every applicable requirement passes on the first authorized public-validation score. No representation, model, dictionary, selector, threshold, corpus rule, baseline setting, evaluator, or gate may change after validation acquisition.
claim_rule: A public-validation pass supports only the exact track scope. Private-holdout success and independent reproduction are additionally required before state-of-the-art wording; all eligible research-ceiling results must also be beaten before a strongest-ratio or world-best claim.
